data.one_liner: Mathematical and boolean expression evaluator supporting arbitrary precision.
data.what_it_does: Evaluates mathematical and boolean expressions passed as strings, utilizing the decimal package for arbitrary precision arithmetic. It supports variables, custom functions, operators, and various built-in math and logic operations.
use_when: You need to evaluate mathematical expressions parsed from strings or user input
You require arbitrary precision arithmetic for calculations
You want to support custom variables, operators, and functions inside mathematical expressions
avoid_when: You are dealing with high-performance real-time physics engines requiring specialized math pipelines
You need built-in support for hyperbolic functions
strengths: Supports arbitrary precision arithmetic using decimal
Extensive list of built-in math and logic functions and operators
Easy to add custom functions, operators, and variables
weaknesses: The SQRT function is limited to 64-bit precision
